4th Period.workingNow: Reviewing our Getting to Know You results, then browsing classmates' pages to find something you have in common with someone.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub repository live on GitHub Pages with a home page (single image + page menu) and at least one content page — first name only, no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can explore classmates' pages and identify something we have in common, then share it in a Google Classroom discussion post.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.28 — Collaborate respectfully with others when reviewing and giving feedback on digital work.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: Timed transition — post yesterday's time (3 min)
We do: review our Getting to Know You quiz results together (7 min)
I do: model browsing a classmate's page respectfully (5 min)
You do: browse 2–3 classmates' repos, find something in common (15 min)
Discussion post (Google Classroom): name a classmate + one thing in common (15 min)
Continue adding to your own pages if time remains (5 min)
4th Period.connections: Monday we filled out our Getting to Know You quiz, and today we use those answers to look at each other's work and find things we have in common — building our sense of community as a class. Tomorrow we'll polish what we've made and reflect on our first week.
